title: Barracuda Email Security Gateway: two flaws patched on November 2 are being exploited in real attacks. CVE-2026-116606: authorization bypass leading to command injection.
content_md:
Barracuda Email Security Gateway: due falle corrette il 2/11 risultano sfruttate in attacchi reali. CVE-2026-116606: bypass dell'autorizzazi

via Mastodon https://trust.barracuda.com/security/pre-authentication-authorization-bypass-command-injection

CVE-2026-116606.evidence: Barracuda confirms the Nov 2 authorization-bypass flaw is exploited in real attacks.

CVE-2026-111560.evidence: Reported exploited in real attacks alongside CVE-2026-116606.
